definition: A form used to report contributions to and distributions from this document (HSAs), figure HSA deductions, and report income and additional taxes related to HSA eligibility and qualified medical expenses.

includes.text: Reports HSA contributions and deductions for the tax year
Reports distributions made from HSAs during the tax year
Calculates deductible HSA contributions based on coverage type and eligibility
Reports qualified medical expenses paid from HSA distributions

excludes.text: Reports dependent care expenses and credits
Reports itemized deductions including medical expenses
Reports rental income, royalties, and supplemental income from multiple sources
excludes.quote: Schedule E (Form 1040) - Supplemental Income and Loss

discriminators.text: Focuses on HSA contributions and distributions rather than dependent care expenses and credits
Reports HSA-specific deductions and distributions rather than itemized deductions from all sources
Reports HSA account activity rather than rental, royalty, or other supplemental income from multiple sources
